plain_text:
Minutes  
Holyoke COA Board of Directors Meeting  
Friday October 9th, 2026  
 
 
ATTENDANCE: Barbara Grady, Kyong Cruz (Zoom), Nikki Perrier, Len Brouillette, Wayne Klinge, Priscilla Garcia,  
Dian McCollum, Julita Rojas, Cappie Glica, and Navae Rodriguez, Exec. Director 
 
Meeting called to order by Barbara, 10:10 am. 
 
Minutes for September were approved with a correction that minutes for July were approved. Motion by 
Wayne, seconded by Len, approved by all.  
 
Financial Report: Good with budget.  On personnel, there is a negative number as people have been using  
FMLA.  The difference will be transferred from the regular salary lines. The State Formula grant is being 
disbursed in periodic installments.  Financial report motion to approve by Cappie, seconded by  Wayne, 
approved by all.  
 
Old Business:  
 Program update:  Tricia did a great job organizing the Health Fair; good feedback, people enjoyed it. All 
scheduled vendors showed up, but some started packing up around 12:15.  Perhaps tell them that if 
they don’t stay until the end, they might not be invited back.  There will be a push this fall to make sure 
that everyone is using their swipe card.  Open enrollment begins 10/15. Two upcoming trips:  Nov. trip 
to JFK Library, Dec. trip to Deerfield.  Dec 11 will be the day for the holiday party.  Thursday, Nov 19,  
for the Thanksgiving Lunch.  Tix on sale next week.  Rainbow supper club hosted Magic Wings Butterfly 
Conservatory at their Oct meeting.  
 Building updates:  Graffiti on the electrical box has been painted over.  HVAC system will be looked 
over to see if improvements can be made to efficiency. Len installed new shelves in the garden closet.  
Met with 3D Home Improvement, who will most likely be chosen to install the new lobby shelving. 
 Staffing updates: currently no staffing needs. 
 
New Business  
 Our regular December meeting conflicts with the date for the holiday party.  As of now, we will 
not meet in December unless an important issue comes up.  
 Potential for Saturday art programs starting up again on an every other week schedule. 
 Meeting adjourned, 10:47 am. 
 
 
Respectfully submitted by,  
 
Kyong M Cruz  
 
Kyong M Cruz  
Secretary
